findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_competitor_visibility_gap, get_citation_sources, get_top_cited_urls_for_topic, get_prompt_performance, get_ai_answers, audit_page, get_seo_rankings, get_site_audit · Public sink: get_visibility_score, get_share_of_voice, get_competitor_comparison, get_ai_answers, get_market_ai_presence · Destructive: get_account.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_competitor_visibility_gap, get_citation_sources, get_top_cited_urls_for_topic, get_prompt_performance, get_ai_answers, audit_page, get_seo_rankings, get_site_audit · Public sink: get_visibility_score, get_share_of_voice, get_competitor_comparison, get_ai_answers, get_market_ai_presence · Destructive: get_account

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
